# Taylor Swift Praises Phoebe Bridgers’ New Album ‘Lost Weekend’ in Birthday Post

Effingham, IL / Effingham Radio

Aug 19, 2026 | 1:27 AM

Image Press Agency / Depositphotos.com

Taylor Swift made a brief return to social media to celebrate Phoebe Bridgers’ 32nd birthday and show support for her latest music. In an Instagram Story shared for the occasion, Swift reposted Bridgers’ album announcement and praised her new record, Lost Weekend.

results.content: Born in Pennsylvania, Taylor Swift began writing songs and playing guitar as a pre-teen. Relocating with her family to Hendersonville, TN, in 2004, she signed with Sony/ATV Tree Music Publishing, making her – at age 14 – the youngest writer in that company’s history. She soon signed with Big Machine Records, which in 2006 released her self-titled debut album that included “Teardrops On My Guitar” (2008 BMI Country Song of the Year).
